posts.cooked:
Eleven players last night -- on an off week?! Maybe it's the pending GenCon excitement.

 

So, moving forward we're going to schedule every two weeks, rather than four.

 

Brock is going to take over working w/ the staff at Arsenal to keep us on the Tue schedule.

 

Our table (Bunker, TLT, Scholar, Young Legacy) beat up on Mad Bomber Blade and then decided, just for fun, to leave our hero and env setup out and bring out The Matriarch, on advanced, with H card plays to start. We were able to beat her, but it was a hard-fought battle.

 

Than, for kicks, we took on Advanced Voss while attempting to use an all-support team. We started with Legacy, Argent Adept, and Dark Visionary, but couldn't think of a fourth hero and ended up with Eternal Haka. With that much healing and deck control we had many, many rounds. Haka eventually got out Savage Mana and used a few rampages and Taiha hits to swallow almost every card in Voss' deck. What had appeared to be a no-win situation, quickly turned into a route of the enemy. Savage Mana was the obvious Best Card, but Twist the Ether on Haka made a huge difference, too.
